title: A-S 103 - 3D
description: A-S 103 is an introductory course in compositional strategies within spatial forms for sculptural practices. This studio course is essential for any student who wants to visually communicate in art studio, design, digital media and art education. Students will work with a variety of contemporary art/design materials and approaches, while learning and integrating the basic vocabulary of composition in art and design. These works will be informed by a wide variety of contemporary artists and designers. Students will work in an iterative process to develop ideas, problem solve, enhance creativity and articulate personal expression.
attributes: Meets UK Core Intellectual Inquiry in Arts and Creativity
